name: hello-world-wasm-typescript
description: A Bifrost WASM plugin example in TypeScript (AssemblyScript)

scripts.build: node init && asc assembly/index.ts --outFile build/hello-world.wasm --optimize --runtime stub --use abort=
scripts.build:debug: node init && asc assembly/index.ts --outFile build/hello-world.wasm --debug --runtime stub --use abort=
